GROUP: Inside terminal-psi, codec and semantics: | 44. **Descriptor analyses in two copies each**: liveness (`sem/descriptors.rs:628-713` and `:398-534`), forward still-valid analysis (`:7952-7999` and `:8258-8325`), subject rewriting (`:1071-1145` and `:2981-3077`, the second ignores foreign terms and has no depth bound), origin conversion (`sem/descriptor_replay.rs:571-645`, `:4098-4172`, `:5324-5337`, `:5526-5594`; the first two differ on what an `Argument` origin needs), the exact-projection test five times (`sem/descriptor_replay.rs:389, 656, 1073, 2477, 384`), the budget formula four times (`:1321, 1832, 1856, 3693`).

GROUP: Inside terminal-psi, codec and semantics: | 45. **Other pairs**: reference-leaf enumerators (`sem/references.rs:183` and `:1584`, different traversal order); "contains a claim" (`sem/structural.rs:518`, `sem/storage.rs:378`); constant-origin resolution (`sem/bytes.rs:984-1052` and `:1117-1141`); `place_type` and `quotient_place_type` identical (`sem/content_transformations.rs:1735`, `:3565`); fact roster linear and hashed (`sem/substitution.rs:404`, `:561`); two place-rebase rules, one of which discards the prefix (`sem/substitution.rs:319-345`, `:370-383`); two semantic-row tables built the same way (`sem/scalars.rs:1337`, `sem/structural.rs:4551`), each revalidated in full on every lookup (`sem/scalars.rs:1423`, `sem/structural.rs:3463-3465`).
